allow: Bash(powershell -Command "Get-WinEvent -LogName System -MaxEvents 100 | Where-Object {$_Message -match ''disk|delete|format|volume''} | Format-Table TimeCreated, Id, Message -Wrap")
Bash(powershell -Command 'Get-WinEvent -LogName System -MaxEvents 100 | Where-Object {$_.Message -match ""disk|delete|format|volume""} | Select-Object TimeCreated, Id, Message | Format-Table -Wrap')

Bash(powershell -Command 'Get-WinEvent -LogName ""Microsoft-Windows-Storage-Driver/Operational"" -MaxEvents 50 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object TimeCreated, Id, Message | Format-Table -Wrap')

Bash(powershell -Command 'Get-EventLog -LogName System -Newest 50 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object {$_.Source -match ""disk|Ntfs|stor""} | Format-Table TimeGenerated, Source, Message -Wrap')

Bash(powershell -Command 'Get-WinEvent -LogName Security -MaxEvents 200 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object {$_.Id -in 4660,4663,4656,4658} | Select-Object TimeCreated, Id, Message | Format-Table -Wrap')
